department: Department of Mechanical Engineering and Department of Aerospace Engineering (Bagley College of Engineering)

deadline.value: The college review date for Fall is June 1, unless a department sets an earlier one.
deadline.quote: The application deadlines for all students are as follows: Fall Semester – June 1

gre_general.value: GRE General is required for applicants whose bachelor's is not from an EAC/ABET-accredited program; the catalog does not say whether Indian degrees count.
gre_general.quote: An entering graduate student with a bachelor’s degree from a program that is not accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology (EAC/ABET) must submit GRE general-test scores

toefl_min.value: Department minimum is TOEFL 550 paper-based (79 iBT).
toefl_min.quote: An international student must have a minimum TOEFL score of 550 PBT (79 iBT) or IELTS score of 6.5

ielts_min.value: Department minimum is an IELTS score of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: An international student must have a minimum TOEFL score of 550 PBT (79 iBT) or IELTS score of 6.5

entry_route.value: Exceptionally qualified bachelor's students can enter the Engineering PhD directly; the degree is also offered after a master's.
entry_route.quote: For exceptionally qualified bachelor’s students, the BCoE offers several direct-admit to the PhD pathways into its various doctoral programs
